__NOTOC__
'''Black''' can refer to the following:

==[[Aiel]]==
* [[Black Cliffs]] - a [[sept]] of the [[Nakai]] Aiel.
* [[Black Rock]] - a sept of the [[Shaarad]] Aiel.
* [[Black Water]] - a sept of the Nakai Aiel.
* ''[[Seia Doon]]'' - an [[Aiel warrior society]] whose name means "Black Eyes" in the [[Old Tongue]].

==Black Tower==
* [[Black Tower]] - the headquarters of the [[Asha'man]].
* [[Attack on the Black Tower]] - [[Elaida a'Roihan]]'s failed attempt to destroy the Black Tower.
* [[Black Tower Alliance]] - an alliance between the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]] and the Black Tower.
* [[Black Tower Foretelling]] - prophecies of the Black Tower.

==''[[Ter'angreal]]''==
* [[Bent black rod]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that can invert the weaves of the person holding it.
* [[Black and white bird]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that may be used in long-range communication.
* [[Flexible black rod]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that can cause pain.
* [[Fluted black rod]] - a ''ter'angreal'' that can create [[balefire]].

==Chapter titles==
* ''[[Lord of Chaos/Chapter 42|The Black Tower]]'' - the forty-second chapter of ''[[Lord of Chaos]]''
* ''[[Crossroads of Twilight/Chapter 7|Blacksmith's Puzzle]]'' - the seventh chapter of ''[[Crossroads of Twilight]]''.
* ''[[The Gathering Storm/Chapter 35|A Halo of Blackness]]'' - the thirty-fifth chapter of ''[[The Gathering Storm]]''.

==Black Ajah==
* [[Black Ajah]] - [[Darkfriend]] [[Aes Sedai]].
* [[Liandrin's Group of Black Sisters]] - a group of thirteen Black Ajah sisters that fled the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|998}}.

==Others==
* [[Black Hills]] - a region between the [[Borderlands]] and the [[Caralain Grass]].
* [[Black Fever]] - a plague that devastated the [[Westlands]], ending in {{fy|939}}.
* [[Black Years]] - a period of [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s reign.
* [[Black Wind]] - another name for ''Machin Shin''.
* ''doon'' - the Old Tongue word for black.
